snippet.title: Shutter Story - Reveal Trailer
snippet.description:
WISHLIST NOW ON STEAM - https://store.steampowered.com/app/3798860/Shutter_Story/

Examine a family's photo album for signs of the paranormal in Shutter Story. 

STEAM - https://store.steampowered.com/app/3798860/Shutter_Story/
DISCORD - https://discord.gg/4MZhntx
X/Twitter – https://twitter.com/frostwood_int 
Bluesky - https://bsky.app/profile/frostwood.bsky.social

When Eli insists his family is being haunted, you dismiss it - until he shows you the photos. Now he needs to convince his parents, and as budding photo editor, that’s where you come in. Armed with the photo and video analysis software SpectralAware™ 2.1, tweak exposure settings and work with a variety of filters to reveal the horrors hiding in plain sight. 

Consult an exhaustive manual detailing every type of anomaly to classify your observations in the right categories. Choose wisely, because Eli’s family’s fate depends on how well you do your job.  Between your desktop investigations, explore Eli’s house in first-person sections as the horror begins to unfold around you. As you piece together the family history, you’ll learn the true reason behind the hauntings – inherited and passed down through generations.
